d:
"Akhiyan Te Ja Ladiyan" is a vibrant Balochi Bhangra Dhamal written and composed by Daler Mehndi, sung in collaboration with Qawwali singers Ustad Sher Ali, Ustad Mehr Ali and Ejaz Sher Ali in Siraiki style of singing.
Bhangra takes centre stage in this video of the song that narrates the pangs of the lovelorn. It’s a celebration where the yearning of a lover, the separation, the cupids strike, is danced to, with all heart.
The energetic dance performances by the creative dancers from Folking Desi beautifully complement the rhythm and energy crafted by Daler Mehndi.
